description: Source control, CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, and IaC — build failures, deployment frequency, and secret exposure.
name: DevOps & CI/CD
quickFacts: Forward CI/CD logs (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) via webhook or log file monitoring to Splunk.

useCases.title: Commit Activity Trending
useCases.value: Commit velocity indicates team productivity and project health. Drops may signal blockers; spikes may precede release issues.

useCases.title: Branch Protection Bypasses
useCases.value: Direct pushes to protected branches bypass code review, introducing unreviewed code to production. Detection ensures process compliance.

useCases.title: Pull Request Metrics
useCases.value: PR cycle time affects development velocity. Long review times indicate bottlenecks; abandoned PRs indicate scope or alignment issues.

useCases.title: Secret Exposure Detection
useCases.value: Secrets committed to source control are immediately compromised. Detection within minutes enables rapid rotation before exploitation.

useCases.title: Repository Access Audit
useCases.value: Repository permission changes can expose source code to unauthorized users. Audit trail supports IP protection and compliance.

useCases.title: Force Push Detection
useCases.value: Force pushes overwrite git history, potentially destroying code and audit trails. Detection ensures accountability.

useCases.title: GitHub Actions Workflow Run Time Trending
useCases.value: Workflow duration growth over time indicates growing tech debt, resource constraints, or inefficient pipeline design. Early detection enables optimization before velocity degrades.

useCases.title: GitHub Actions Billing Usage
useCases.value: Approaching included minutes quota risks unexpected overages or workflow throttling. Proactive monitoring prevents billing surprises and supports capacity planning.

useCases.title: Branch Protection Bypass Detection
useCases.value: Complements UC-12.1.2 by correlating audit `protected_branch.policy_override` with push events for investigation packs.

useCases.title: Force Push to Protected Branches
useCases.value: Narrows UC-12.1.6 to default/release branches where history rewrite has highest impact.

useCases.title: Sensitive File Commit Detection
useCases.value: Paths such as `.env`, `id_rsa`, `kubeconfig`, and `*.pem` in commits indicate credential sprawl even before secret scanning fires.

useCases.title: Repository Permission Changes
useCases.value: Team `maintain`/`admin` grants and visibility changes to `public` are higher risk than member adds (UC-12.1.5).

useCases.title: PR Review Bypass Detection
useCases.value: Merges with zero approvals or with only self-approval violate four-eyes policies.

useCases.title: Fork Network Suspicious Activity
useCases.value: Sudden stars/forks from new accounts or geo clusters can precede supply-chain attacks or leaked-token cloning.

useCases.title: CODEOWNERS File Modification Monitoring
useCases.value: Attackers may weaken review requirements by editing `CODEOWNERS` or `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

useCases.title: Large File Commit Detection
useCases.value: Large blobs bloat repos, bypass review in diff viewers, and may hide embedded data.

useCases.title: Signed Commit Enforcement
useCases.value: Unsigned commits on protected branches weaken non-repudiation; verify GPG/SSH sig status.

useCases.title: Stale Branch Cleanup Tracking
useCases.value: Long-lived branches accumulate merge debt and stale code; tracking supports automated deletion policies.

useCases.title: Repository Webhook Health
useCases.value: Failed webhook deliveries break CI, security scanning, and Splunk ingestion—monitor delivery logs and HTTP status.

useCases.title: Code Scanning Alert Trends
useCases.value: GitHub Advanced Security CodeQL/code scanning alert open/close rates show remediation velocity and new debt.

useCases.title: Build Success Rate Trending
useCases.value: Declining build success rates indicate code quality issues, flaky tests, or infrastructure problems. Trending drives improvement.

useCases.title: Build Duration Monitoring
useCases.value: Increasing build times slow development velocity. Detection enables build optimization and infrastructure right-sizing.

useCases.title: Deployment Frequency (DORA)
useCases.value: Deployment frequency is a key DORA metric indicating engineering capability maturity. Higher frequency correlates with better outcomes.

useCases.title: Lead Time for Changes (DORA)
useCases.value: Lead time measures the commit-to-production pipeline efficiency. Shorter lead times enable faster value delivery and incident response.

useCases.title: Failed Deployment Tracking
useCases.value: Failed deployments cause service disruption. Rapid detection enables rollback decisions. Change failure rate is a DORA metric.

useCases.title: Pipeline Queue Time
useCases.value: Long queue times indicate insufficient CI/CD runner capacity, slowing developer feedback loops and delivery velocity.

useCases.title: Test Coverage Trending
useCases.value: Declining test coverage increases risk of undetected bugs. Trending ensures quality standards are maintained.

useCases.title: Security Scan Results in Pipeline
useCases.value: SAST/DAST/SCA findings in CI/CD pipelines catch vulnerabilities before they reach production. Tracking ensures security gates work.

useCases.title: Jenkins Executor Utilization
useCases.value: Busy executors as % of total and queue wait time indicate CI capacity. High utilization with long queue times signals need for additional agents or executor scaling.

useCases.title: Jenkins Node Offline Detection
useCases.value: Build agents going offline impacts CI capacity and causes job failures. Rapid detection enables agent recovery or failover before queue backlog grows.

useCases.title: GitLab CI Runner Availability
useCases.value: Runner registration status and job queue time affect CI throughput. Offline or paused runners cause jobs to wait or fail; monitoring ensures runner fleet health.

useCases.title: GitLab Pipeline Duration Trending
useCases.value: Pipeline getting slower over time indicates growing tech debt or resource constraints. Trending enables proactive optimization before developer velocity degrades.

useCases.title: Jenkins Agent Offline Alerts
useCases.value: Operational paging when executors disappear—complements UC-12.2.10 with severity tiers and agent labels (prod vs dev).

useCases.title: Pipeline Stage Duration Regression
useCases.value: Stage-level regression (e.g., `test` stage) surfaces before overall job duration crosses SLA (UC-12.2.2).

useCases.title: Build Artifact Integrity Verification
useCases.value: Compares published artifact checksums/Sigstore signatures against CI-recorded values to detect tampering at rest.

useCases.title: Deploy Approval Bypass Detection
useCases.value: Production deploys without change ticket or approval group in CD system (Spinnaker, Argo Rollouts, Harness).

useCases.title: Parallel Build Resource Contention
useCases.value: Runner saturation lengthens CI pipelines and causes flaky tests that block releases. Correlating saturation metrics with P95 job duration justifies autoscaling investment and prevents false 'code reg…

useCases.title: Flaky Test Detection
useCases.value: Tests that pass/fail without code changes waste time and hide real failures; quarantine candidates identified by pass rate variance.

useCases.title: Deployment Frequency Tracking
useCases.value: DORA dashboard slice—deployments per service per day with team and application tags (extends UC-12.2.3).

useCases.title: Lead Time for Changes (Percentile)
useCases.value: p95 lead time exposes tail latency hiding in averages (UC-12.2.4).

useCases.title: Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
useCases.value: Time from incident detection or deploy failure to successful restore—core DORA metric.

useCases.title: Change Failure Rate
useCases.value: Ratio of failed deployments or hotfix-required releases to total deployments—DORA metric.

useCases.title: Pipeline Secret Rotation Compliance
useCases.value: CI/CD credentials (vault tokens, cloud API keys) approaching expiry without rotation break builds and create risk.

useCases.title: Build Queue Wait Time SLA
useCases.value: SLA-focused view of queue delay—% of jobs waiting >5 min (extends UC-12.2.6).

useCases.title: Test Coverage Regression
useCases.value: PRs that reduce line coverage vs main branch—visibility for governance (pair with CI gates).

useCases.title: Pipeline Resource Utilization
useCases.value: CPU/memory per runner job—right-sizing and spot vs on-demand mix.

useCases.title: Artifact Repository Health
useCases.value: Full artifact repositories prevent builds from publishing. Storage monitoring and cleanup policy verification ensures CI/CD continuity.

useCases.title: Dependency Vulnerability Alerts
useCases.value: Vulnerable dependencies in the software supply chain are a primary attack vector. Tracking ensures timely patching.

useCases.title: Package Download Anomalies
useCases.value: Unusual package download patterns may indicate dependency confusion attacks or compromised internal packages.

useCases.title: License Compliance Tracking
useCases.value: Open-source license violations create legal risk. Automated tracking ensures compliance before code reaches production.

useCases.title: Terraform State Drift Detection
useCases.value: Planned vs. applied resource count and drift between declared and actual infrastructure indicate manual changes or state corruption. Detection ensures IaC remains source of truth and supports complia…

useCases.title: Container Image Vulnerability Scan Failures
useCases.value: CI gate failures when Trivy/Grype/ECR scanning cannot pull image or scanner errors—distinct from found CVEs (UC-12.3.2).

useCases.title: Package Dependency Audit Alerts
useCases.value: New AGPL/GPL or typosquat package names in lockfiles—policy engine output beyond CVE severity.

useCases.title: Artifact Retention Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Verifies cleanup jobs deleted snapshots per policy; stale artifacts past retention indicate failed garbage collection.

useCases.title: SBOM Generation Compliance
useCases.value: CycloneDX/SPDX missing for release builds breaks supply-chain attestation requirements (EO 14028).

useCases.title: Artifact Signing Verification
useCases.value: Cosign/Notary verification results at deploy time—signature missing or wrong key.

useCases.title: Package Provenance Tracking
useCases.value: SLSA provenance predicate links artifact digest to git source SHA and builder ID—detects builds not from trusted pipelines.

useCases.title: Registry Storage Growth
useCases.value: Daily growth rate of container/NPM registry—forecast disk exhaustion (extends UC-12.3.1).

useCases.title: Terraform Plan/Apply Tracking
useCases.value: Every Terraform apply changes infrastructure. Full audit trail enables change management, impact analysis, and rollback decisions.

useCases.title: Configuration Drift Detection
useCases.value: Drift from declared IaC state indicates manual changes that bypass change control, creating inconsistency and security risks.

useCases.title: Ansible Playbook Outcomes
useCases.value: Tracking Ansible run results ensures configuration management is working. Failed tasks indicate systems in unknown state.

useCases.title: Puppet/Chef Compliance Reports
useCases.value: Configuration management compliance ensures systems match desired state. Non-compliance indicates security or operational risk.

useCases.title: IaC Policy Violations
useCases.value: Policy-as-code (OPA/Sentinel) prevents non-compliant infrastructure from being provisioned. Tracking blocked deployments validates governance.

useCases.title: Pipeline Failure Root Cause Trending
useCases.value: Recurring failure causes (e.g., flaky tests, env issues) slow delivery. Trending root causes supports targeted remediation and stability.

useCases.title: Container Image Build and Push Audit
useCases.value: Unauthorized or untagged image pushes can introduce risk. Auditing build and push events supports supply chain security and compliance.

useCases.title: Release Gate and Approval Lag
useCases.value: Long approval or gate wait times delay releases. Monitoring gate duration and approval latency supports process improvement.

useCases.title: Feature Flag and Experiment Rollout Monitoring
useCases.value: Feature flags and experiments affect user experience. Monitoring rollout percentage and error rate per flag supports safe rollouts and rollback.

useCases.title: Deployment Rollback and Canary Health
useCases.value: Failed canaries or automatic rollbacks indicate bad releases. Tracking rollback rate and canary metrics ensures safe deployments.

useCases.title: ArgoCD Application Sync Status
useCases.value: Out-of-sync or degraded applications in ArgoCD indicate GitOps drift or deployment failures. Detection ensures desired state matches cluster state and enables rapid remediation.

useCases.title: Terraform Plan Drift Detection
useCases.value: Scheduled CI `terraform plan` runs that show changes when no pipeline apply occurred—focused operational view vs UC-12.4.2.

useCases.title: CloudFormation Stack Drift
useCases.value: AWS `DetectStackDrift` results show live resources diverging from template—essential for CloudFormation-centric teams.

useCases.title: Ansible Playbook Failure Tracking
useCases.value: Failure rate per playbook and run—trending layer on top of UC-12.4.3 outcomes.

useCases.title: Policy-as-Code Violation Trending
useCases.value: OPA, Sentinel, or Conftest denials over time—spikes after new policy rollout (extends UC-12.4.5).

useCases.title: IaC Module Version Compliance
useCases.value: Terraform module sources below approved minimum semver—reduces stale or vulnerable module usage.

useCases.title: ArgoCD Sync Status Failures
useCases.value: Failed or stuck sync operations leave clusters diverging from Git and block releases; surfacing them quickly limits blast radius and restores desired state.

useCases.title: ArgoCD Drift Detection
useCases.value: Live cluster drift from Git-defined manifests risks untracked changes and audit gaps; detecting drift prioritizes reconciliation before incidents or compliance findings.

useCases.title: Flux Reconciliation Health
useCases.value: Unhealthy Flux `Kustomization`/`HelmRelease` resources stop automated delivery; monitoring reconciliation ensures continuous GitOps and catches controller or source errors early.

useCases.title: GitHub Actions Workflow Failure Rate
useCases.value: A rising workflow failure rate signals flaky pipelines, bad merges, or infra issues that slow delivery and can block production paths.

useCases.title: GitHub Actions Runner Queue Depth
useCases.value: Deep job queues delay CI feedback and releases; tracking queue depth distinguishes runner capacity problems from workflow volume spikes.

useCases.title: GitLab CI Pipeline Duration Regression
useCases.value: Sudden pipeline duration increases waste compute budgets and slow merges; regression detection isolates stages, runners, or dependencies that changed.

useCases.title: Deployment Rollback Frequency Tracking
useCases.value: Frequent rollbacks indicate release quality or progressive-delivery issues; tracking frequency supports blameless review and release process tuning.

useCases.title: Helm Release Health Monitoring
useCases.value: Failed or pending Helm releases leave workloads partially updated or broken; monitoring release status prevents silent partial deploys.

useCases.title: Kustomize Build Error Tracking
useCases.value: Kustomize build failures block manifests from applying; early detection shortens fix time for overlay, patch, or base reference mistakes.

useCases.title: GitOps Deployment Lead Time
useCases.value: Measuring Git commit-to-production lead time exposes bottlenecks in review, CI, and sync so teams can optimize end-to-end delivery speed.

useCases.title: DORA Metrics Trending Dashboard
useCases.value: Deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and restore time summarize delivery health; month-over-month trends show whether engineering investments actually improved flow or reliability.

useCases.title: Security Scan Finding Trending
useCases.value: Seeing new, open, and closed findings per sprint proves whether shift-left scanning and remediation keep pace with development; spikes in new findings after dependency upgrades are expected—flat open…

useCases.title: Build Queue Wait Time Trending
useCases.value: Queue wait reflects runner capacity and pipeline fan-in; rising waits delay feedback and release trains even when job success rates look fine.

useCases.title: Container Image Build Time Trending
useCases.value: Longer image builds slow every downstream deploy; sprint-level trends catch Dockerfile regressions, bloated layers, or registry latency before they dominate CI budgets.
